headline: TEX @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.54 at KCR 3.27, with a projected total of 7.81. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward KCR: TEX moved -0.45 runs while KCR moved +0.27, changing the projected margin by -0.71 runs. NRFI probability rose +12.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Stephen Kolek has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, Vinnie Pasquantino, Wyatt Langford, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Justin Foscue, Tyler Tolbert because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
